manuscript_title: Real-Background Mixed Training and Plume-Aware Representation for OCO-3 Power-Plant CO2 Emission Estimation
aggregation: Arithmetic mean across seeds per scene, then arithmetic mean across retained scenes per plant; errors equally averaged over eight plants.
seed_variability: Evaluate each seed separately after plant aggregation; report mean and sample SD (ddof=1).

post_hoc_gate.rule: Use HPR if HPR plant prediction <10 or >16; otherwise mixed CNN.
post_hoc_gate.status: post hoc exploration on the same benchmark

reference_interpretation: Annual emission references are not overpass-time instantaneous ground truth.
